stories.title: Rate Limit Policy Schema and Configuration
stories.description: Define rate limiting policy schema including request thresholds (per minute/hour), key dimensions (IP, session, API key), and enforcement rules. Add configuration support via environment variables or centralized config.

stories.title: Core Rate Limiting Middleware
stories.description: Implement FastAPI middleware to enforce rate limits per defined policy. Track request counts per key (IP/session) and reject requests exceeding thresholds with appropriate HTTP status (429).

stories.title: Rate Limit Storage and Tracking Mechanism
stories.description: Implement in-memory or Mongo-backed counter mechanism for tracking request frequency with TTL-based expiration. Ensure atomic updates and efficient cleanup of expired counters.
stories.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py; ASSUMPTION: No existing rate tracking store implemented; GAP required

stories.title: Rate Limit Response Handling and Client Feedback
stories.description: Standardize API responses for throttled requests including error payload, retry-after headers, and user-friendly messaging compatible with frontend ChatWindow handling.

stories.title: Rate Limiting Tests and Integration Validation
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating enforcement of rate limits, correct rejection behavior, TTL reset behavior, and no impact to normal request flows under threshold.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py; ASSUMPTION: No existing rate limit tests; GAP required
